The '''Quermia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]]. A [[Battle of the Quermia system|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was fought here.
